name: Findley — Product Discovery for WooCommerce
author: louizdk

sections.description:
Findley helps customers discover the right WooCommerce product by answering a short set of preference sliders.

The plugin is designed for stores that want a guided selection flow instead of a plain product grid. It works well for coffee, wine, chocolate, furniture, clothing, skincare, and similar categories where customer taste or preference matters.

Features include:

  • Configurable matching axes and slider labels
  • WooCommerce product matching powered by product-specific scores
  • Custom product fields and product scoring for WooCommerce products
  • Default product-card presentation
  • Text customisation for the frontend experience
  • Local lead capture with optional marketing consent

Dependencies:

  • WooCommerce
  • Advanced Custom Fields
sections.installation:
1. Install through the WordPress plugins screen, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Findley through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce and Advanced Custom Fields are installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Findley to configure matching axes, product fields, branding text, and leads.
  5. Add the [findley_product_finder] shortcode to any page where you want the finder to appear.
sections.faq:
Does this work only for coffee?

No. The plugin was originally built for coffee, but it now supports any product category where customers can be guided by taste, style, or preference.

What plugins does Findley require?

Findley requires:

  • WooCommerce
  • Advanced Custom Fields

How do products get matched?

Each enabled WooCommerce product gets a score for each configured axis. When a customer moves the sliders, the plugin ranks products based on how closely those product scores match the selected preferences.

Can I capture email leads?

Yes. The plugin stores leads locally and sends the requested match result email using your WordPress mail configuration.
